Haa-Meem
yeh kalam uss zaat ki taraf say nazil kiya jaraha hai jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .
arbi Quran ki shakal mein yeh woh kitab hai jiss ki aayaten ilm hasil kernay walon kay liye tafseel say biyan ki gaee hain ,
yeh Quran khushkhabri denay wala bhi hai , aur khabrdar kernay wala bhi . phir bhi inn mein say aksar logon  ney mun morr rakha hai jiss kay nateejay mein woh suntay nahi hain ,

aur ( payghumber SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam say ) kehtay hain kay :  jiss cheez ki taraf tum hamen bula rahey ho , uss kay liye humaray dil ghilafon mein liptay huye hain , humaray kaan behray hain , aur humaray aur tumharay darmiyan aik perda haeel hai . lehaza tum apna kaam kertay raho , hum apna kaam ker rahey hain .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay :  mein to tum hi jaisa aik insan hun . ( albatta ) mujh per yeh wahi nazil hoti hai kay tumhara khuda bus aik hi khuda hai . lehaza tum apna rukh seedha ussi ki taraf rakho , aur ussi say maghfirat maango . aur bari tabahi hai unn mushrikon kay liye
jo zakat ada nahi kertay ,   aur unn ka haal yeh hai kay aakhirat kay woh bilkul hi munkir hain .
. ( albatta ) jo log emaan ley aaye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay liye beyshak aisa ajar hai jiss ka silsila kabhi tootney wala nahi hai .

keh do kay :  kiya tum waqaee uss zaat kay sath kufr ka moamla kertay ho jiss ney zameen ko do din mein peda kiya , aur uss kay sath doosron ko shareek thehratay ho-? woh zaat to saray jahano ki perwerish kernay wali hai .

aur uss ney zameen mein jamay huye pahar peda kiye jo uss kay oopper ubhray huye hain , aur uss mein barkat daal di ,   aur uss mein tawazun kay sath uss ki ghizayen peda ken sabb kuch chaar din mein   tamam sawal kernay walon kay liye barabar !

phir woh aasman ki taraf mutawajjah huwa , jabkay woh uss waqt dhuyen ki shakal mein tha ,   aur uss say aur zameen say kaha :  chalay aao , chahye khushi say ya zabardasti .  dono ney kaha :  hum khushi khushi aatay hain .

chunacheh uss ney do din mein apney faislay kay tehat unn kay saat aasman bana diye , aur her aasman mein uss kay munasib hukum bhej diya .   aur hum ney uss qareeb walay aasman ko chiraghon say sajaya , aur ussay khoob mehfooz kerdiya . yeh uss zaat ki napi tuli mansooba bandi hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ka ilm bhi mukammal .
phir bhi agar yeh log mun morren to keh do kay :  mein ne tumhen uss karrkay say khabar daar kerdiya hai jaisa karrka aad aur samood per nazil huwa tha .

yeh uss waqt ki baat hai jab unn kay paas payghumber ( kabhi ) unn kay aagay say aur ( kabhi ) unn kay peechay say   yeh paygham ley ker aaye kay Allah kay siwa kissi cheez ki ibadat naa kero . unhon ney kaha kay :  agar humara perwerdigar chahta to farishtay bhejta . lehaza jiss baat kay sath tumhen bheja gaya hai , hum uss ko manney say inkar kertay hain .

phir aad ka qissa to yeh huwa kay unhon ney zameen mein nahaq takabbur ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kiya , aur kaha kay :  kon hai jo taqat mein hum say ziyada ho ?  bhala kiya unn ko yeh nahi soojha kay jiss Allah ney unn ko peda kiya hai , woh taqat mein unn say kahen ziyada hai ? aur woh humari aayaton ka inkar kertay rahey .

chunacheh hum ney kuch manhoos dino mein   unn per aandhi ki shakal mein hawa bheji takay unhen dunyawi zindagi mein ruswai kay azab ka maza chakhayen . aur aakhirat ka azab uss say bhi ziyada ruswa kernay wala hai , aur unn ko koi madad moyassar nahi aaye gi .

rahey samood , to hum ney unhen seedha raasta dikhaya tha . lekin unhon ney seedha raasta ikhtiyar kernay kay muqablay mein andha rehney ko ziyada pasand kiya , chunacheh unhon ney jo kamai ker rakhi thi , uss ki wajeh say unn ko aesay azab kay karrkay ney aa pakra jo sarapa zillat tha ,
aur jo log emaan ley aaye thay , aur taqwa ikhtiyar kiye huye thay , unn ko hum ney nijat dey di .
aur uss din ka dhiyan rakho jab Allah kay dushmanon ko jama ker kay aag ki taraf ley jaya jaye ga , chunacheh unhen toliyon mein baant diya jaye ga .
yahan tak kay jab woh uss ( aag ) kay paas phonch jayen gay to unn kay kaan , unn ki aankhen aur unn ki khalen unn kay khilaf gawahi den gi kay woh kiya kuch kertay rahey hain .

woh apni khalon say kahen gay kay :  tum ney humaray khilaf kiyon gawahi di . ?  woh kahen gi kay :  hamen ussi zaat ney bolney ki taqat dey di hai jiss ney her cheez ko goyai ata farmaee .  aur wohi hai jiss ney tumhen pehli baar peda kiya tha , aur ussi ki taraf tumhen wapis ley jaya jaa raha hai .

aur tum ( gunah kertay waqt ) iss baat say to chup hi nahi saktay thay kay tumharay kaan , tumhari aankhen aur tumhari khalen tumharay khilaf gawahi den , lekin tumhara gumaan yeh tha kay Allah ko tumharay boht say aemal ka ilm nahi hai .
apney perwerdigar kay baaray mein tumhara yehi gumaan tha jiss ney tumhen barbad kiya , aur issi kay nateejay mein tum unn logon  mein shamil hogaye jo sarasar khasaray mein hain .
abb inn logon  ka haal yeh hai kay agar yeh sabar keren tab bhi aag hi inn ka thikana hai , aur agar yeh maazrat chahen to yeh unn logon  mein say nahi hain jinn ki maazrat qubool ki jati hai .

aur hum ney ( duniya mein ) inn per kuch sathi musallat ker-diye thay jinhon ney inn kay aagay peechay kay saray kamon ko khushnuma bana diya tha ,   chunacheh jo doosray jinnaat aur insan inn say pehlay guzar chukay hain , unn kay sath mil ker ( azab ki ) baat inn per bhi sachi hoi . yaqeenan woh sabb khasara uthaney walon mein say hain .
aur yeh kafir ( aik doosray say ) kehtay hain kay :  iss Quran ko suno hi nahi , aur iss kay beech mein ghull macha diya kero takay tum hi ghalib raho .
iss liye hum inn kafiron ko sakht azab ka maza chakhayen gay , aur yeh ( duniya mein ) jo bad-tareen kaam kiya kertay thay , uss ka poora poora badla den gay .
yehi hai saza Allah kay dushmanon ki jo aag ki soorat mein hogi . ussi mein unn ka daemi thikana hoga , jo iss baat ka badla hoga kay woh humari aayaton ka inkar kiya kertay thay .

aur yeh kafir log kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen unn jinnaat aur insanon dono ki soorat dikhaiye jinhon ney hamen gumrah kiya tha , takay hum unhen apney paon talay aisa ronden kay woh khoob zaleel hon .

. ( doosri taraf ) jinn logon  ney kaha hai kay :  humara rab Allah hai  aur phir woh uss per sabit qadam rahey to unn per beyshak farishtay ( yeh kehtay huye ) utren gay kay :  naa koi khof dil mein lao , naa kissi baat ka ghum kero , aur uss jannat say khush hojao jiss ka tum say wada kiya jata tha .

hum duniya wali zindagi mein bhi tumharay sathi thay , aur aakhirat mein bhi rahen gay . aur iss jannat mein her woh cheez tumharay hi liye hai jiss ko tumhara dil chahye , aur iss mein her woh cheez tumharay hi liye hai jo tum mangwana chahao ,
yeh sabb kuch uss zaat ki taraf say pehli pehli meyzbani hai jiss ki bakhshish bhi boht hai , jiss ki rehmat bhi kamil .
aur uss shaks say behtar baat kiss ki hogi jo Allah ki taraf dawat dey , aur naik amal keray , aur yeh kahey kay mein farmanbardaron mein shamil hun .

aur naiki aur badi barabar nahi hoti . tum badi ka difaa aesay tareeqay say kero jo behtareen ho .   nateeja yeh hoga kay jiss kay aur tumharay darmiyan dushmani thi , woh dekhtay hi dekhtay aisa hojaye ga jaisay woh ( tumhara ) jigri dost ho .
aur yeh baat sirf unhi ko ata hoti hai jo sabar say kaam letay hain , aur yeh baat ussi ko ata hoti hai jo baray naseebay wala ho .
aur agar tumhen shetan ki taraf say kabhi koi kachoka lagay to shetan mardood say Allah ki panah maang liya kero .   beyshak woh her baat sunney wala , her baat janney wala hai .

aur ussi ki nishaniyon mein say hain yeh raat aur din aur sooraj aur chaand . naa sooraj ko sajda kero , naa chaand ko , aur sajda uss Allah ko kero jiss ney unhen peda kiya hai , agar waqaee tumhen ussi ki ibadat kerni hai .
phir bhi agar yeh ( kafir ) takabbur say kaam len , to ( kertay rahen ) kiyonkay jo ( farishtay ) tumharay rab kay paas hain , woh din raat uss ki tasbeeh kertay hain , aur woh uktatay nahi hain .

aur uss ki nishaniyon mein say yeh bhi hai kay tum zameen ko dekhtay ho kay woh murjhai parri hai . phir junhi hum ney uss per paani utaara , woh harkat mein aagae , aur uss mein barhotry peda hogaee . haqeeqat yeh hai kay jiss ney uss zameen ko zinda kiya , wohi murdon ko bhi zinda kernay wala hai . yaqeenan woh her cheez per qadir hai .

jo log humari aayaton kay baaray mein tairrah raasta ikhtiyar kertay hain ,   woh hum say chup nahi saktay . bhala batao kay jiss shaks ko aag mein daal diya jaye , woh behtar hai , ya woh shaks jo qayamat kay din bey khof o khatar aaye ga ? ( acha ) jo chahao , kerlo , yaqeen jano kay woh tumharay her kaam ko khoob dekh raha hai .
beyshak ( unn logon  ney boht bura kiya hai ) jinhon ney naseehat ki iss kitab ka inkar kiya jabkay woh unn kay paas aa-chuki thi , halankay woh bari izzat wali kitab hai ,

jiss tak batil ki koi rasai nahi hai , naa uss kay aagay say , naa uss kay peechay say . yeh uss zaat ki taraf say utaari jaa rahi hai jo hikmat ka malik hai , tamam tareefen ussi ki taraf loatti hain .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say jo baaten kahi jaa rahi hain , woh wohi hain jo tum say pehlay payghumberon say kahi gaee then . yaqeen rakho tumhara perwerdigar maghfirat kernay wala bhi hai , aur dardnak saza denay wala bhi .

aur agar hum iss ( Quran ) ko ajmi Quran banatay to yeh log kehtay kay :  iss ki aayaten khol khol ker kiyon nahi biyan ki gaeen-? yeh kiya baat hai kay Quran ajmi hai , aur payghumber arbi-?    keh do kay :  jo log emaan layen , unn kay liye yeh hidayat aur shifa ka saman hai , aur jo emaan nahi latay , unn kay kanon mein daat lagi hoi hai , aur yeh ( Quran ) unn kay liye andheray mein bhatakney ka saman hai . aesay logon  ko kissi door daraz jagah say pukara jaa raha hai .

aur hum ney musa ko bhi kitab di thi , phir uss mein bhi ikhtilaf huwa . aur agar tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik baat pehlay hi tey naa kerdi gaee hoti , to inn logon  ka moamla chuka hi diya gaya hota . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh log aesay shak mein parray huye hain jiss ney inn ko khaljaan mein daal rakha hai .

jo koi naik amal kerta hai , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye kerta hai , aur jo koi burai kerta hai , woh apney hi nuqsan kay liye kerta hai , aur tumhara perwerdigar bandon per zulm kernay wala nahi hai .

qayamat ka ilm ussi ki taraf lotaya jata hai . aur Allah kay ilm kay baghair naa phalon mein say koi phal apney shagoofon say nikalta hai , aur naa kissi mada ko hamal thehrta hai , aur naa uss kay koi baccha peda hota hai . aur jiss din woh inn ( mushrikon ) ko pukaray ga kay :  kahan hain meray woh shareek-?  to woh kahen gay kay :  hum to aap say yehi arz kertay hain kay hum mein say koi abb iss baat ka gawah nahi hai ( kay aap ka koi shareek hai )
aur pehlay yeh log jinn ( jhootay khudaon ) ko pukara kertay thay , unn ko abb unn ka koi suragh nahi milay ga , aur woh samajh jayen gay kay unn kay liye abb bachao ka koi raasta nahi hai .
insan ka haal yeh hai kay woh bhalai maangney say nahi thakta , aur agar ussay koi burai choo jaye to aisa mayyus hojata hai kay her umeed chorr bethta hai .

aur jo takleef ussay phonchi thi , agar uss kay baad hum ussay apni taraf say kissi rehmat ka maza chakha den to woh laziman yeh kahey ga kay :  yeh to mera haq tha , aur mein nahi samajhta kay qayamat aaney wali hai , aur agar mujhay apney rab kay paas wapis bheja bhi gaya to mujhay yaqeen hai kay uss kay paas bhi mujhay khush haali hi zaroor milay gi .  abb hum inn kafiron ko yeh zaroor jatlayen gay kay unhon ney kiya amal kiye hain , aur unhen aik sakht azab ka maza zaroor chakhayen gay .
aur jab hum insan per koi inaam kertay hain to woh mun morr leta aur pehlo badal ker door chala jata hai , aur jab ussay koi burai choo jati hai to woh lambi chorri duayen kernay lagta hai .

. ( aey payghumber ! inn kafiron say ) kaho kay :  zara mujhay batao kay agar yeh ( Quran ) Allah ki taraf say aaya hai , phir bhi tum ney iss ka inkar kiya to uss shaks say ziyada gumrah kon hoga jo ( uss ki ) mukhalifat mein boht door nikal gaya ho-?

hum unhen apni nishaniyan kainat mein bhi dikhayen gay aur khud unn kay apney wajood mein bhi , yahan tak kay unn per yeh baat khul ker samney aajaye kay yehi haq hai . kiya tumharay rab ki yeh baat kafi nahi hai kay woh her cheez ka gawah hai-?
yaad rakho kay yeh log apney rab ka samna kernay kay moamlay mein shak mein parray huye hain . yaad rakho kay woh her cheez ko ehatay mein liye huye hai .
